title: Inline approval cards, Y/N keyboard shortcut, approval bar, timeout
description: Implement approval UI: inline approval card in transcript (tool name, pretty-printed args, approve/deny buttons), persistent approval bar at bottom of transcript area, Y/N keyboard shortcut (only when not in editable field), 5-min timeout with warning, resolution states (pending/approved/denied/already-resolved). Approval decision calls client.Approve().
acceptance_criteria: Approval card appears inline in transcript when approval-needed event received
Card shows: tool name, pretty-printed args, approve/deny buttons
Approval bar: persistent at bottom, shows pending approval summary
Y/N keyboard shortcut: works when not in editable field, approves/denies
Resolution states: pending, approved, denied, already-resolved all displayed correctly
client.Approve() is called with correct session_id, tool_call_id, decision
